knowledge.purpose: A page's own table of contents: its sections as links to their anchors, an h3 under its h2, the section being read marked as the visitor scrolls.
useCases: "On This Page" column beside a documentation page
Contents list at the top of a long article or policy page
Section index beside a handbook chapter
antiPatterns: Navigation between pages — use layout.sidebar or layout.navbar
A short page with one or two sections — the headings are enough
Items that are not this page's anchors — it marks the section in view by its id
knowledge.implementation: A <nav> named by its title (the title prop, else the app word ui.toc) over links to #anchors, in the order the page shows them. items: [{label, href, level?}] — href is the section's anchor as the content renders it (prose writes GitHub-style ids: "Track A — run" is #track-a--run), level 3 sits 12px under the level 2 above it. trackScroll (default true): while the visitor scrolls, the last section whose heading has passed under the top bar carries aria-current="location" and the current ink. The block never reads the page to find its items, so the first frame already draws them. Its look is tokens with fallbacks: --pw-toc-ink, --pw-toc-hover-ink, --pw-toc-current-ink, --pw-toc-title-ink, --pw-toc-title-weight, --pw-toc-title-tracking, --pw-toc-title-gap, --pw-toc-h2-weight, --pw-toc-h3-weight, --pw-toc-indent, --pw-toc-gap, --pw-toc-line-height. On a phone each link is a 44px target.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading over the list, which also names the navigation landmark ("On This Page"). Unset: the app's ui.toc. Write it in the app's language.

props.name: items
props.description: The page's sections in order: label, the section's anchor (#options) and its level (2, or 3 for a sub-section).

props.name: trackScroll
props.description: Mark the section being read as the visitor scrolls (aria-current="location").

tokens.name: hoverInk
tokens.description: Ink of an entry under the pointer.

tokens.name: currentInk
tokens.description: Ink of the entry for the section in view.

tokens.name: lineHeight
tokens.description: Line height of the title and the entries.

tokens.name: entryWeight
tokens.description: Weight of a top-level entry (an h2).

tokens.name: subEntryWeight
tokens.description: Weight of a nested entry (an h3).

tokens.name: depthIndent
tokens.description: How far a nested entry sits in.

tokens.name: titleSpaceBelow
tokens.description: Space between the title and the first entry.
